title: 每个人的指纹都不一样
subtitle: 手指上的小地图
character: wearing a deep indigo t-shirt, grey trousers and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration in indigo relief print style, bold flat shapes with visible carved texture, deep indigo, warm cream and one soft coral accent, simple and graphic

pages.zh:
我用手指蘸了点颜料，
在纸上按了一下。
纸上留下一个小圆印，
里面全是细细的线。
这是什么呢？
pages.scene: The little boy presses one fingertip onto a sheet of paper on a table, leaving a small mark, looking at it closely.

pages.zh:
那是「指纹」。
每根手指的指尖上，
都有一圈一圈的细线，
凹的地方是沟，
凸起来的地方是脊。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one fingertip shown very large on a cream background, covered in fine concentric ridge lines. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
指纹的花样大致分三种：
像圆圈一圈套一圈的，
像水流拐个弯的，
还有像帐篷尖顶的。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three fingerprint patterns in a row on a cream background: one made of closed concentric circles, one where the lines curve over and come back, one where the lines rise to a peak in the middle. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
这些线是在妈妈肚子里
就长好的。
那时候皮肤长得快，
哪里挤一下、哪里拉一下，
线就那样定下来了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one fingertip on a cream background with a few small arrows pressing in from the sides, and the ridge lines bending where the arrows push. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
长好以后就不再变了。
人长大，手变大，
花样还是那个花样，
只是整个变大了一点。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two fingertips side by side on a cream background with exactly the same ridge pattern, the right one drawn larger than the left. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
就算是双胞胎，
长得一模一样，
指纹也不一样。
全世界没有两个人的指纹
是相同的。
pages.scene: Two children who look exactly alike standing side by side on a cream background, each holding up one hand. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
十根手指，
十个不一样的花样。
连你自己的左手和右手，
都对不上。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: ten fingerprint ovals arranged in two rows of five on a cream background, every one with a different ridge pattern. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
为什么手上要长这些线呢？
因为有了它们，
手才抓得稳。
就像轮胎上的花纹，
不容易打滑。
pages.scene: One hand on a cream background gripping a round cup, with the ridge lines drawn on the fingertips. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
手指一碰东西，
就会留下一点点油，
照着那些线印上去。
所以门把手上、杯子上，
常常有看不见的指纹。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one cup on a cream background with three faint fingerprint marks on its side, drawn in a lighter tone. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
警察查案子的时候，
就靠这个认人。
手机和门锁也会认指纹，
因为它独一无二。
pages.scene: One phone lying on a cream background with a small fingerprint symbol glowing on its screen. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以洗手很重要。
手上的线又多又深，
脏东西最容易藏在里面。
要用肥皂，
每个指缝都搓到。
pages.scene: Two hands on a cream background rubbing together with soap bubbles around them, under a running tap. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我把十根手指
都按了一遍。
十个小圆印，
没有两个是一样的。
原来我一直带着十张小地图。
pages.scene: The little boy looks at a sheet of paper covered with ten fingerprint marks he has just made, delighted.
